rules.source: EBA 2025 EU-wide stress test, Methodological Note, 2025-01-20
rules.statement: The exercise is carried out on the basis of year-end 2024 figures, and the scenarios will be applied over a period of 3 years from 2025 to 2027.

rules.source: EBA 2025 EU-wide stress test, Methodological Note, 2025-01-20
rules.statement: Static balance sheet: assets and liabilities that mature or amortise within the horizon are replaced with similar instruments; no workout or cure of S3 assets; no capital measures after the reference date.

rules.source: EBA 2025 EU-wide stress test, Methodological Note, 2025-01-20
rules.statement: The same business mix and model throughout the horizon; revenues and costs under zero growth and a stable business mix.

rules.source: EBA 2025 EU-wide stress test, Methodological Note, 2025-01-20
rules.statement: Banks are not permitted to replace S3 exposures; new S3 exposures move into the stock of S3, keeping the total exposure constant; no cures, charge-offs or write-offs within the 3-year horizon.

rules.source: EBA 2025 EU-wide stress test, Methodological Note, 2025-01-20
rules.statement: The initial residual maturity is kept constant for credit REA.

rules.source: EBA 2025 EU-wide stress test, Methodological Note, 2025-01-20
rules.statement: A constant balance sheet for impairments: replacement assets keep the credit risk characteristics and stage.
